summary: Iteration 34: Full backend + frontend coverage of Claim Packet per-document actions (view/edit/delete/move/save-pdf/arrange) and packet-level Send/Merge. 12 pytest tests PASSED (1 skipped: reorder needs 2+ items in freshly-built packet). All 9 frontend flows verified end-to-end on the deployed URL.

issues: React hydration warning in console: <span> cannot be a child of <option> — cosmetic only (does not affect function). Likely from an i18n <span> wrapper inside <option> in cf-status. Consider using plain text in <option> children.

action_items: (Optional) Fix hydration warning: render translated status labels as text (not wrapped in <span>) inside cf-status <option>.
(Optional) Consider auto-refreshing selected packet after send-email 502 (currently refreshSelected only fires on success).
critical_code_review_comments: claims.py _merge_items_pdf skips non-pdf/image sources silently (logger.error). Merged PDF may exclude .doc/.docx/.xls/.xlsx items without user warning — UI should hint which items will/won't be merged.

GET /claims/{cid}/merged sets status=complete BEFORE streaming; if the response is aborted client-side after status update, the packet is still marked complete. Consider marking complete only after successful write, or accept as intentional.

send_packet_email uses 502 for both 'not configured' and 'send failed'. The code path currently returns 400 for not-configured (good), but the frontend just shows the detail string via apiErr — that's fine.

Claims.js line 220: Merge & Save PDF button fires POST /to-folder (fire-and-forget with .catch(()=>{})) followed by GET /merged — if to-folder fails, user gets no feedback. Consider chaining/handling explicitly.
seed_data_creation: Fresh from-date packet was built and deleted per test module. Existing target packet 7dc91480-... remained but had 1 item removed during UI delete test (now 1 item, still status=complete).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest requires REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var: `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://veteran-care-portal.preview.emergentagent.com pytest backend/tests/test_iteration_34_claims.py`. To rebuild the packet: POST /claims/from-date {patient_id: <Test Patient>, date: '2026-07-15'} — pulls the day's invoice + progress note. Send-email will fail 502 for @example.com recipients (Resend restriction) and for yahoo fallback (connection closed) — this is an ENV limitation, not a code bug. Preview modal (opened by claim-item-view) does NOT close on Escape — close via clicking the X button or clicking outside, otherwise subsequent clicks are intercepted by the overlay.
